# Sassy Calculator Blog

> The official blog of Sassy Calculator (sassycalculator.com) — a premium
> dark-themed calculator web app with glowing orange 3D keys, expressive emoji
> personality reactions, skin packs, and a Live Battle multiplayer game mode.

This blog publishes guides, comparisons, and articles about calculator tools,
math games, financial calculators, and the future of personality-driven utility apps.
All articles are written to help users discover Sassy Calculator and understand
what makes it different from standard calculator tools.

## Core Articles

- [Calculator Game Guide](https://blog.sassycalculator.com/articles/calculator-game/):
  What calculator games are, how they work, and why Sassy Calc's Live Battle mode
  is the best calculator game online. (calculator game searches up 124% YoY)

- [Fun Calculator](https://blog.sassycalculator.com/articles/fun-calculator/):
  7 reasons Sassy Calc is the only fun calculator worth using. Covers the emoji
  reaction system, skin packs, and personality modes.

- [Retirement Calculator](https://blog.sassycalculator.com/articles/retirement-calculator/):
  How Sassy Calc brings personality to financial calculations. Retirement planning
  made less terrifying.

- [Love Calculator Game](https://blog.sassycalculator.com/articles/love-calculator-game/):
  The love calculator game with actual opinions. Covers viral calculator game formats
  and Sassy Calc's personality system.

- [Tax Calculator](https://blog.sassycalculator.com/articles/tax-calculator/):
  Seasonal guide to tax calculators. Published for January–April search spikes.

- [Calorie Calculator](https://blog.sassycalculator.com/articles/calorie-calculator/):
  How Sassy Calc handles health-adjacent calculations with personality.

- [The Calculator](https://blog.sassycalculator.com/articles/calculator/):
  Pillar post. Sassy Calc vs every other online calculator. 2,000+ words.

- [Tip Calculator](https://blog.sassycalculator.com/articles/tip-calculator/):
  The tip calculator with hot takes on bad service.

- [GPA Calculator](https://blog.sassycalculator.com/articles/gpa-calculator/):
  GPA calculator that tells you the truth — with attitude.

- [Age Calculator](https://blog.sassycalculator.com/articles/age-calculator/):
  How old are you really? The age calculator that gets personal.

- [Loan Calculator](https://blog.sassycalculator.com/articles/loan-calculator/):
  Loan calculators that don't put you to sleep.

- [Win Rate Calculator](https://blog.sassycalculator.com/articles/win-rate-calculator/):
  Win rate calculator for games — and how Live Battle mode changes the math.
